title: Beyond the Sequentiality Bottleneck: A Hybrid Diffusion-Autoregressive Framework for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.28584v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autoregressive models (ARMs) face a "Sequentiality Bottleneck" in reasoning, while diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallelism but lack semantic coherence. To addresses both limitations, we propose Collaborative Reasoning Asymmetric Learning (CoRAL), a hybrid framework via an Asymmetric Planner-Executor (APE) architecture: a DLM Planner generates K diverse reasoning trajectories in parallel, while a large ARM Executor selects the optimal plan and synthesizes the final answer. To train the Planner effectively, we introduce Reward-Guided Denoising for CoT (RDC), which integrates outcome-based rewards into the diffusion process to steer it toward goal-directed reasoning. Experiments on vision-language benchmarks show that CoRAL significantly outperforms prior diffusion-based methods and achieves competitive performance against strong ARMs, achieving both superior efficiency and quality.

translated_title: 超越顺序性瓶颈：一种用于高效多模态推理的混合扩散-自回归框架
translated_abstract: 自回归模型在推理过程中面临“顺序性瓶颈”，而扩散语言模型虽然提供了并行性，却缺乏语义连贯性。为了同时解决这两个局限性，我们提出了协同推理非对称学习，这是一个基于非对称规划器-执行器（APE）架构的混合框架：DLM规划器并行生成K条多样化的推理轨迹，而大型ARM执行器则从中选出最优方案并合成最终答案。为了有效训练规划器，我们引入了面向思维链的奖励引导去噪，该方法将基于结果的奖励融入扩散过程，引导其朝着目标导向的推理方向发展。在视觉-语言基准上的实验表明，CoRAL显著优于以往基于扩散的方法，并在与强大的自回归模型对比时取得了具有竞争力的性能，同时实现了卓越的效率与质量。
tldr: 该论文提出CoRAL混合框架，通过非对称规划器-执行器架构让扩散语言模型并行生成多样化推理轨迹、自回归模型择优合成最终答案，并利用奖励引导去噪训练规划器，从而在多模态推理中同时实现高效率与高质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoRAL, a hybrid diffusion-autoregressive framework with an asymmetric Planner-Executor architecture where a DLM planner generates diverse reasoning trajectories in parallel and a large ARM executor synthesizes the final answer, trained via reward-guided denoising, achieving both superior efficiency and quality in multimodal reasoning.
